newsitem.title: GREECE: PUBLISHER EPIPHANIA FILES FOR BOURSE LISTING.
newsitem.headline: PUBLISHER EPIPHANIA FILES FOR BOURSE LISTING.

text.p: Mass media and publishing concern Epiphania SA filed for listing on the Athens bourse's small-cap parallel market, it said in a statement.
Epiphania will issue 367,500 ordinary bearer shares with a par value of 100 drachmas with 350,000 of these offered to the public. The remaining 17,500 shares will be orivately placed.
Issue advisor and lead underwriter is Telesis Securities.

Epiphania, founded in 1990, saw 1995 sales grow 26 percent to 1.38 billion drachmas while pretax profit reached 279 million, up 34 percent on 1994, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
